title: 3.1.0.3 + 3.2.0.1 No Pump (Dana RS) Pairing possible
symptom: In the pairing process the pump goes into communication according to the pairing codes, the arrows appear but then the process stops. This happens reliably 12 times in a row with a DANA RS V3 from 03/2023, while another older RS works well.
cause: The pairing dialogue doesn't get scrollable when showing more content than the current device resolution allows, so the user isn't able to reach the 'cancel / ok' buttons. This is a small device/screen issue.
fix: Workaround was connecting pump via big-screen phone and import saved settings to Jelly. Additionally, a commit was made to fix the issue (bfacfd925590d458d08fd29ddbf09dcc3fd91996).
evidence_quote: Issue detected/solved, it was a display resolution problem. The pairing dialogue doesn't get scrollable when showing more content than the current device resolution allows, so the user isn't able to reach the "cancel / ok" buttons (or can't even guess they are there).
